entry_item.definition: T. Yi dam; S. istha-devatā; svādhi-daivatā, çraddhā-deva A divinity chosen as personal protector or patron by a lama, who selects him before initiation and never discloses his identity before his death. The lama feels himself under the personal surveillance and protection of his yidam during all his Life. At his funeral procession a picture of the jidam is carried in front, facing the coffin.
